answer: In this PoA design, an agent identity is issued only after remote attestation verifies the enclave’s MRENCLAVE and a hardware-rooted key proves possession. The registry binds each identity to that measurement and unique hardware key, so copying a VM image cannot reproduce its credential; another accepted identity requires provisioning another genuine enclave on physical silicon, not software duplication. This is hardware scarcity, not an ocean fable: ferrous servers still must pass verification.
